promptZh: 阅读短文，在空白处填入 1 个适当的单词或括号内单词的正确形式。

explanation.summaryZh: 短文讲述中学生清理小镇河流、成立“蓝河”志愿队并让河水变清的故事。
explanation.ruleZh: 抓住 decide to do、worth doing 等固定搭配；分词作状语用 asking；定语从句 whose 表示“它的”；比较级由 than 提示。

evidence.quote: To everyone's surprise, the town replied
and birds have returned to the banks

segments.text: For years, the river that runs through our town was badly polluted. Plastic bags floated on the water, and the fish
(die) one after another. Last spring, a group of middle school students decided
(do) something about it. They began by picking up rubbish along the banks every weekend. At first, some people laughed at
(they), but the students never gave up. They also wrote to the local government,
(ask) for more dustbins and warning signs near the water. To everyone's surprise, the town replied
(quick) and set up a volunteer team
name was 'Blue River'. Now, two years later, the river is much
(clean) than before, and birds have returned to the banks. People can walk or even fish there,
it is still not perfectly clean. Last month, a newspaper reporter said the students' effort was worth
even small actions can change the place we live in,' one student said proudly.

gaps.label: 第1空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 描述过去陆续发生的情况，填 were dying（过去进行时）或 died 均可。

gaps.label: 第2空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: decide to do sth 表示“决定做某事”，填 to do。

gaps.label: 第3空
gaps.clue: 用括号内代词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 介词 at 后接人称代词宾格，填 them。

gaps.label: 第4空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 主语 they 与 ask 是主动关系，用现在分词作伴随状语，填 asking。

gaps.label: 第5空
gaps.clue: 用括号内形容词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 修饰动词 replied 用副词 quickly。

gaps.label: 第6空
gaps.explanationZh: 定语从句中先行词是 team，空后是名词 name，用 whose 表示“它的名字”。

gaps.label: 第7空
gaps.clue: 用括号内形容词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 由 much 与比较含义可知用比较级 cleaner。

gaps.label: 第8空
gaps.explanationZh: 前后句意转折：人们可以散步垂钓，尽管河水还没有完全变干净，填 though 或 although。

gaps.label: 第9空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: be worth doing 表示“值得做”，填 praising。

gaps.label: 第10空
gaps.explanationZh: learned 后的宾语从句是陈述句，用 that 引导。
